problem_statement: The stack has no spinel property codec to encode and decode Dnssd host, service and key-registration records. When a Dnssd host/service/key object is to be communicated over the spinel link, the codec must serialize the host (host name and address list), the service (host name, service instance, service type, sub-type labels, TXT data, port, priority, weight, TTL) and the key record (name, optional service type, key data, resource record class, TTL) along with the request id and the callback context, and the decoder must reconstruct the same values. The behavior required is a round-trip codec: encoding an object and then decoding the resulting frame must reproduce every field, the request id and the callback data.
